title: Weight loss pills online: the Wegovy pill, Foundayo, their prices, and a doctor of your own
summary: Weight loss pills online: compare the Wegovy pill, Foundayo and Contrave, November 2026 cash prices, telehealth fees, and $40 FutureClinic visits.
body_markdown:
## How do you buy weight loss pills online safely?


Use a prescription from a licensed doctor at a state-licensed pharmacy. Per[FDA BeSafeRx](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/besaferx-your-source-online-pharmacy-information/considering-online-pharmacy) , safe online pharmacies require a prescription, list a US address and phone, and employ a licensed pharmacist; avoid sites without prescriptions, with deep discounts, or selling[counterfeit or research-labeled GLP-1s](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/postmarket-drug-safety-information-patients-and-providers/fdas-concerns-unapproved-glp-1-drugs-used-weight-loss) and[tainted diet supplements](https://www.fda.gov/drugs/medication-health-fraud/tainted-weight-loss-products) .[NABP](https://safe.pharmacy/buy-safely/) says nearly 95% of websites offering prescription-only drugs online operate illegally; verify a .pharmacy domain.

## Who shouldn't take a weight loss pill?


People with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or MEN 2 must not take the Wegovy pill or Foundayo (boxed warning for thyroid C-cell tumors); stop Wegovy for suspected pancreatitis and avoid it while breastfeeding. Contrave carries a boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behaviors and must not be used with uncontrolled high blood pressure, a seizure disorder, anorexia or bulimia, chronic opioid use, or within 14 days of an MAOI.[NIDDK](https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/weight-management/prescription-medications-treat-overweight-obesity) says not to take any weight-loss medicine if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. Per NIDDK, patients average 3% to 12% extra weight loss at one year and likely regain some weight after stopping. FutureClinic is not for emergencies; call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
